nodes.label: MultiCardioFusion (v5 revision)
nodes.rationale: Explainable ECG-proxy-enhanced clinical prediction framework for heart disease; v5 re-tests every v4 claim under a controlled, leak-free protocol (5x10 repeated CV, 94 configurations). Full system AUC 0.902 [0.858,0.945]; clinical-only performs equally.

nodes.label: UCI Cleveland Heart Disease Dataset (D1, 303 patients, 13 clinical vars)
External UCI sites: Hungary, Switzerland, VA Long Beach
ECG-proxy features (23 features from restecg, oldpeak, slope, thalach, exang)
nodes.rationale: Approximates ECG information from exercise-ECG clinical columns because Cleveland and PTB-XL have different patients; found to add no information since they are deterministic functions of existing columns.

nodes.label: Proxy-feature fusion (vs true patient-level multimodal fusion vs parallel ECG benchmarking)
nodes.rationale: Work explicitly makes no claim of true patient-level fusion since no Cleveland patient has a PTB-XL recording.

nodes.label: tsfresh EfficientFCParameters descriptors (777 -> 568 via VarianceThreshold), Lead II
nodes.rationale: Single Lead II chosen to keep feature space manageable for N=303; loses spatial information.

nodes.label: Leakage-aware pipeline (imputation, derivation, scaling, resampling inside training folds)
Nadeau-Bengio corrected resampled t-test
nodes.rationale: Fold scores from repeated CV overlap so a naive t-interval is too narrow.

nodes.label: SMOTE oversampling
nodes.rationale: Produces implausible non-integer categorical codes; removing it does not change AUC; class weighting or SMOTE-NC on raw rows recommended.

nodes.label: Cross-attention with sequence length 1
nodes.rationale: With one key the softmax weight is exactly 1, so attention reduces to a linear map of the clinical branch; removed from proposed system.

nodes.label: TreeSHAP explanations
nodes.rationale: Post-hoc and associational; used descriptively, not in prediction.

nodes.label: SHAP ranking stability (fold Spearman 0.90, top-5 Jaccard 0.74)
Control experiments: noise, shuffled proxy, non-ECG features (Table VIII)
External validation on three hospitals (Table XVII)
Hold-out sensitivity over 200 random splits (seed 42 at 95th pct)
nodes.rationale: Single 61-patient hold-out can create apparent gains; v4 +7.04pp came from favourable split.

nodes.label: Oversampling before CV leakage (inflates AUC to 0.916)
Platt scaling calibration
nodes.rationale: Recommended over isotonic for ~240 patients; ensemble calibration slope 1.37 (under-confident).

nodes.label: Dominant predictors cp, ca, thal
nodes.rationale: ca and thal come from the same work-up as the angiographic label, making model a post-test classifier.
